parameter_scope: all formal trainable decoder+head float32 parameters
candidate: native MLR backward/clip/AdamW/scheduler inside isolated snapshot, restore afterwards
raw_gradient: same clipped MLR gradient, equal Euclidean norm
probe: eval all modules, learned GMM variance, terminal expert NLL; no sampled actions
deadband: tau_i=max(2*repeat_abs_difference,32*float32_eps*max(1,abs(base_NLL_i))); prediction uses same units and tau_i; frozen before directional outcomes
statistics_unit: start then equal seed-transition strata; report neutral coverage and undefined metrics
classification: alpha1 reliable A; .5/.25 reliable B; .125 reliable B with explicit1/8 extension; <=.0625 reliable C; else D; engineering rules not theorem
hvp_trigger: alpha1 unreliable AND smallest-alpha median Spearman improves>=.15 OR sign accuracy improves>=.10 (the two improvements are parenthesized); require smallest-alpha decisive coverage>=.5
hvp_starts: first middle/late point per seed-transition (12), plus last middle point each stratum(6), plus last late in first2 sortedstrata(2);20 total
hvp_probes: first3 frozen windows per oldtask (3 or6); true NLL double-autograd HVP, no Fisher
normal_path_restore: exact source witness for all120 starts; no new carrier on mismatch
quantization: Norm(actual float32 written displacement-alpha*d), actual norm and Cauchy bound ||h||*rounding_norm recorded. Main prediction alpha*h dot d remains unchanged.
raw_comparison: two self-direction fidelity curves do not prove relative same-target superiority; additionally wrong-direction proxy h dot d_raw against actual AdamW y
execution: reconstruct only missing origins from nearest saved anchor/previous restored origin; no formal checkpoints or solver called
raw_support_rule: At alpha1 all six strata paired median Spearman AdamW-minus-raw >=.05, sign and harm recall nondecreasing, precision decline<=.02; consistent reverse Spearman<=-.05 and sign<=0 gives NOT_SUPPORTED; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Same-target raw proxy is separate.
premeasurement_finalization: Implementation completed after state-only parity; no directional outcome has been measured. Corrected HVP trigger logical OR and quantization description before scientific run.
displacement_arithmetic: d0 is the exact binary64 difference between two true float32 parameter states; perturbation addition in binary64 then one float32 write. Model, native gradients and optimizer stay float32. Alpha1 must bitwise reconstruct native parameters.
